fusions.name: Turnkey Throw
fusions.desc: Throws an iron key-bar for 12 damage, up to 1.4 times that at 6 tiles. It stuns the target for 1 second and leaves it [Inescapable] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Iron Door
fusions.desc: Slams an iron door into the target for 30 damage that ignores armour, leaving it 10% easier to wound and [Suppressed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Lockdown
fusions.desc: Holds every creature within 5 tiles in place for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: No Exemptions
fusions.desc: Your afflictions take hold on enemies that are immune to them, and your armour rises by 6%.
